intentComment: Story 090. Two-phase totalWithdrawal(DOLA, PhusdStableMinter) on the autoDOLA strategy YieldStrategyDola 0x1760E05356Ec1FBBA159C730781dCfB9920524e2: the FIRST call snapshots the minter's principal and starts a 6h wait then a 72h execution window (nothing moves); a SECOND call inside [initiatedAt+6h, initiatedAt+78h] EXECUTES and sends the DOLA to OWNER. This script STARTS THE CLOCK ONLY and refuses to run while a withdrawal is pending (it would execute) - execution belongs to story 092's cutover. The cutover must START >= 6h after the MINED initiate and more than 6h (WINDOW_SAFETY_MARGIN, story 097) before its 78h expiry, i.e. before initiatedAt + 72h (the cutover's Phase 0 refuses later); if that start deadline passes, wait for expiry and rerun this key (lazy expiry makes it re-initiable). The timestamps this script prints are LOCAL-PASS ESTIMATES (--skip-simulation --ledger mines later) - read the mined initiatedAt / start deadline with dola-ys-withdrawal:status. Only the minter is withdrawn: StableStaker V1 exits synchronously via initiateMigration inside the cutover. Run :preview first; dola-ys-withdrawal:status is read-only and safe anytime and prints the phase: WAITING; 'EXECUTABLE - cutover may START (>6h left)'; 'EXECUTABLE but too late to START a cutover (<6h left): wait for expiry, then re-initiate'; expired - overridden by 'strategy PAUSED - execute will revert' while the strategy is paused (story 097).

No change to preflight or the single totalWithdrawal call.
